ruleDefinitions.name: Indicator Removal on Host - Clear Mac System Logs
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects deletion of local audit logs

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/rm$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/unlink$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/shred$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/var\\/log.*") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Users\\/.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Library\\/Logs\\/.*")))
